methodology: Operational continuity, not combined sporting identity. Results and championships remain attributed to the constructor identity under which they were earned.

sauber>bmw-sauber.label: Works partnership
sauber>bmw-sauber.note: BMW became the works owner and constructor partner.

bmw-sauber>sauber.label: Ownership change
bmw-sauber>sauber.note: Sauber regained control of the operation after BMW withdrew.

sauber>alfa-romeo.label: Title partnership
sauber>alfa-romeo.note: The Sauber-operated entry competed under the Alfa Romeo constructor name.

alfa-romeo>kick-sauber.label: Title partnership
alfa-romeo>kick-sauber.note: The Sauber-operated entry adopted a new title identity.

kick-sauber>audi.label: Works takeover
kick-sauber>audi.note: The operation became the Audi works team.

minardi>toro-rosso.label: Ownership change
minardi>toro-rosso.note: Red Bull acquired the Minardi operation and renamed it.

toro-rosso>alphatauri.label: Rebrand
toro-rosso>alphatauri.note: The same operation adopted the AlphaTauri constructor identity.

alphatauri>rb.label: Rebrand
alphatauri>rb.note: The same operation adopted the RB constructor identity.

rb>racing-bulls.label: Rebrand
rb>racing-bulls.note: The same operation adopted the Racing Bulls constructor identity.

toleman>benetton.label: Ownership change
toleman>benetton.note: Benetton took control of the Toleman operation.

benetton>renault.label: Works takeover
benetton>renault.note: The operation became Renault’s works constructor.

renault>lotus-f1.label: Ownership change
renault>lotus-f1.note: The Enstone operation competed under the Lotus identity.

lotus-f1>renault.label: Works takeover
lotus-f1>renault.note: Renault returned as the Enstone operation’s works constructor.

renault>alpine.label: Rebrand
renault>alpine.note: Renault renamed its works constructor Alpine.

arrows>footwork.label: Title identity
arrows>footwork.note: The operation competed under the Footwork constructor name.

footwork>arrows.label: Identity restored
footwork>arrows.note: The operation returned to the Arrows constructor name.

coloni>andrea-moda.label: Assets acquired
coloni>andrea-moda.note: Andrea Moda acquired Coloni’s assets, while competing as a separate constructor identity.

tyrrell>bar.label: Assets acquired
tyrrell>bar.note: BAR acquired the Tyrrell operation’s assets and established a new constructor identity.
tyrrell>bar.sourceLabel: Formula 1: how BAR approached its debut

bar>honda.label: Works takeover
bar>honda.note: Honda took full control of the BAR operation.

honda>brawn.label: Management buyout
honda>brawn.note: A management buyout continued the former Honda operation as Brawn GP.

brawn>mercedes.label: Works takeover
brawn>mercedes.note: Mercedes acquired the Brawn operation for its works return.

jordan>midland.label: Ownership change
jordan>midland.note: Midland acquired and renamed the Jordan operation.

midland>spyker.label: Ownership change
midland>spyker.note: Spyker acquired and renamed the Midland operation.

spyker>force-india.label: Ownership change
spyker>force-india.note: New ownership renamed the operation Force India.

force-india>racing-point.label: Assets acquired
force-india>racing-point.note: A new entrant acquired Force India’s operating assets; the sporting identities remain separate.
force-india>racing-point.sourceLabel: Formula 1: Racing Point formed as a new entity

racing-point>aston-martin.label: Rebrand
racing-point>aston-martin.note: The Racing Point operation adopted the Aston Martin constructor identity.

stewart>jaguar.label: Works takeover
stewart>jaguar.note: Ford acquired Stewart and introduced the Jaguar works identity.

jaguar>red-bull.label: Ownership change
jaguar>red-bull.note: Red Bull acquired and renamed the Jaguar operation.

lotus-racing>caterham.label: Rebrand
lotus-racing>caterham.note: The operation adopted the Caterham constructor identity.

osella>fondmetal.label: Ownership change
osella>fondmetal.note: Fondmetal took control of the Osella operation and introduced its own constructor identity.

politoys>iso-marlboro.label: Title identity
politoys>iso-marlboro.note: The operation adopted the Iso-Marlboro constructor identity.

iso-marlboro>frank-williams-racing-cars.label: Identity change
iso-marlboro>frank-williams-racing-cars.note: The operation returned to the Frank Williams Racing Cars identity.

frank-williams-racing-cars>wolf-williams.label: Ownership change
frank-williams-racing-cars>wolf-williams.note: Walter Wolf’s involvement produced the Wolf-Williams identity.

wolf-williams>wolf.label: Restructure
wolf-williams>wolf.note: The operation continued under the Wolf constructor identity after Frank Williams departed.

virgin>marussia.label: Rebrand
virgin>marussia.note: The operation adopted the Marussia constructor identity.

marussia>manor.label: Rebrand
marussia>manor.note: The operation adopted the Manor constructor identity.

ligier>prost.label: Ownership change
ligier>prost.note: The Ligier operation became Prost Grand Prix.

march>leyton-house.label: Title identity
march>leyton-house.note: The operation adopted the Leyton House constructor identity.

leyton-house>march.label: Identity restored
leyton-house>march.note: The operation returned to the March constructor name.
